CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REG.S.
No. S. B. D. 463.
Date 30 - 7 - 30.
July 30, 30.

Gentlemen,

I am in receipt of your letter of
July 24, and have to inform you that, as far as
can be ascertained, no photographic plates were
taken possession of by the police and produced
as evidence in Court. Two photo albums containing
photographs of the SITZ were, however, produced
and handed into Court as exhibits. These have
not been returned to the Police and, as far as is
known, are still in the possession of the Court.

I am, Gentlemen,

Your Obedient Servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches).

Messrs. Russo, Fischer & Wilhelm,
71 Szechuen Road,
Shanghai.

诸位先生：

本人已收到贵方7月24日的来信，现告知如下：据查，警方并未扣押任何照相底片并将其作为证据提交法庭。然而，有两本包含丽都花园（SITZ）照片的相册被提交并作为证物呈堂。这些相册尚未归还警方，且据所知，目前仍由法庭保管。

此致，

你们顺从的仆人，

副总监

上海。

Dear Sir: In re S. M. P. vs. Garcia et al

I beg to acknowledge the receipt of your letter
of the 23d instant relative to the above entitled matter.

According to my recollection, there were two photo
albums containing photographs of the RTTZ. One was
found at 151-C Bubbling Well Road, and one in Mr. Garcia's
apartment at No. 113 Bubbling Well Road. Both of them
were, to the best of my recollection, offered in evidence.

Kindly refer to page 82 of the record. Mr. Yorke

Yes. (Witness produced same.)

亲爱的先生：关于 上海公共租界工部局警务处 诉 Garcia 等人一案

谨此确认收到您本月23日关于上述事项的来信。

据我回忆，有两本包含丽都花园（RTTZ）照片的相册。一本是在静安寺路151-C号发现的，另一本是在 Garcia 先生位于静安寺路113号的公寓里发现的。据我尽力回忆，这两本相册均已被作为证据提交。

请参阅记录第82页。Yorke 先生的证词包括以下内容：

“问：这个柜子里有相册吗？……有。（证人出示了该相册。）

问：请将这本相册中作为证物的照片，与在 Garcia 先生公寓中发现的相册中的照片进行比对，并说明它们是否是同一地点的照片（如果可能的话）？……我认为它们是相同的。XX. 27.

在第93页，我陈述了以下内容：

“法官阁下会记得，在上一次听证会上，

某些

pages.en:
-2-

certain pictures were produced of the RITZ, and
Dr. Fischer complained that the police were not
being fair, because the police did not produce
some other pictures of the MAJESTIC HOTEL, and
some other places. I propose to show that this
RITZ was a Casino, and was shut up by the Chinese
authorities, and Mr. Sutterle, as an old resident --
I say, an old and respected resident -- of Shanghai,
undoubtedly knows something about all this."

If my memory serves me correctly, there were no
plates taken by the Police. There were photographs con-
tained in two books which are the ones above referred to.
The exhibits in question have not, as far as I know,
been given back by the Court to the Police. They should
be still in the possession of the Court. If you so desire,
I shall be glad to go with you to the Court and endeavor
to find the albums referred to.

Yours very truly,

RTB/J                          Municipal Advocate.
pages.zh:
-2-

某些丽都花园（RITZ）的照片被出示，
Fischer 博士抱怨警方不公，因为警方没有出示
其他一些关于马杰斯提克酒店（MAJESTIC HOTEL）
和其他地方的照片。我打算证明这家
丽都花园是一家赌场，并被中国当局查封，而 Sutterle 先生作为一位老居民——
我说，一位受人尊敬的老居民——毫无疑问，
他对这一切有所了解。”

如果我的记忆没错，警方并没有拍摄任何底片。有的只是包含在两本书中的照片，即上述提到的那些。据我所知，相关证物尚未由法庭归还给警方。它们应该仍在法庭保管中。如果您愿意，我很乐意陪同您前往法庭，设法寻找上述相册。

您真诚的，

RTB/J                          市政检察官。

Sir:

We beg to acknowledge with thanks your letter of the
22nd inst., with one photograph.

We have, however, to draw your attention to the fact
that during the trial of the wheel case, the Police intended to
introduce as evidence a lot of photographic plates of the Ritz
and also a large book of photographs of the Ritz. This evidence
was ruled by the Court as not being admissible and the exhibits
were therefore returned to the hands of the Police.

We would therefore be much obliged if you would kindly
continue your investigations and send us the aforementioned arti-
cles at your earliest convenience.

We are, Sir,
Your obedient servants,
MUSSO, FISCHER & WILHELM

先生：

谨此致谢，确认收到您本月22日的来信及所附照片一张。

然而，我们要提请贵方注意，在轮盘赌案件的审判期间，警方曾意图将一批丽都花园（Ritz）的照相底片以及一大本丽都花园的照片作为证据引入。法庭裁定这些证据不予采纳，因此证物被退还给警方。

因此，如蒙贵方继续调查，并在方便时尽早将上述物品寄给我们，我们将不胜感激。

此致，
你们顺从的仆人，
穆安素、费希尔与威廉
由 [签名]

C. & S. B. REGISTER
No. S. B. D. 463.
Date 22 - 7 - 30.

July 22, 30.

Gentlemen,

With reference to your letter of
June 24, 1930, concerning certain books and
photographs removed by the Police from no. 5
Yates Road, I have to inform you that all these
documents were handed into Court as exhibits
during the trial, and were not returned to the
Police with the exception of one photograph
of Mr. Fournier and Mr. & Mrs. de Valle, which
is returned herewith.

I am, Gentlemen,
Your Obedient Servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches).

Messrs. Musso, Fischer & Wilhelm,
71 Szechuen Road,
Shanghai.

（批：Sent. 22/7.）

先生，
除了法庭记录外，本办公室没有其他证物或文件。

71 SZECHUEN ROAD
SHANGHAI
CHINA
June 24th, 1930.

R. C. Aiers Esq.,
Director,
Criminal Investigation Dept.,
Shanghai.

Sir:

Mr. H. Fournier has requested us to communicate with
you with regard to certain books and photographs which were
taken away by the police during the raid on the premises, No.
5, Yates Road, and which were not produced by the police as
evidence during the trial of the case.

Mr. Fournier requests the return of the same, and we
would therefore be obliged if you would kindly let us have
the said books and photographs at your earliest convenience.

Thanking you in anticipation for the assistance ren-
dered, we beg to remain,

Sir,
Your obedient servants,
MUSSO, FISCHER & WILHELM
By [签名]

W/RH

1930年6月24日。

R. C. Aiers 先生，
主任，
刑事调查科，
上海。

先生：

H. Fournier 先生委托我们就警方在突袭耶茨路5号 premises 期间带走、但在案件审判期间未作为证据出示的某些书籍和照片一事与贵方联系。

Fournier 先生要求归还这些物品，因此，如蒙贵方在方便时尽早将上述书籍和照片交予我们，我们将不胜感激。

预先感谢贵方提供的协助，谨此致意，

先生，
你们顺从的仆人，
穆安素、费希尔与威廉
由 [签名]
